posts.zh:
dsh-web-shell 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。右侧停靠的可折叠 Web 终端（xterm.js），经 WebSocket 桥接宿主 PTY：支持 bash/zsh 切换、拖拽调宽，折叠时保留会话。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3d93a2cb65562a44e832.html
posts.en:
dsh-web-shell is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Collapsible right-docked web terminal (xterm.js) bridged to a host PTY over WebSocket: bash/zsh switching, resizable panel, and fold/unfold that keeps the session alive.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3d93a2cb65562a44e832.html
